extracted.intended_audience: Local, divisional, and national journalists/media representatives and community members seeking press contacts or information about The Salvation Army Greater St. Louis
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and contact information for media relations with The Salvation Army Greater St. Louis Metropolitan Area, including which office handles national vs. regional inquiries and who to contact for spokesperson requests and information.

rubrics_metrics.name: National media relations handled by National Headquarters
rubrics_metrics.description: National media relations are handled by National Headquarters in Alexandria, VA, and its public relations consultant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct national media inquiries to the National Headquarters and/or its public relations consultant rather than local offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missouri and Southern Illinois media handled by Divisional Headquarters
rubrics_metrics.description: Missouri and Southern Illinois media relations are handled through the Divisional Headquarters, based in St. Louis, MO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For state/division-level media inquiries within Missouri and Southern Illinois, contact the Divisional Headquarters in St. Louis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local media should contact local Salvation Army representative first
rubrics_metrics.description: All local media are asked to first contact their local Salvation Army representative for requests for spokespersons and other inquiries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before escalating to divisional or national offices, local reporters should contact the local Salvation Army office for spokesperson requests and routine media inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide named media contact with multiple contact methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Media Contacts — Monica Kriegel, Director of Strategic Communications — Email: Monica.Kriegel@usc.salvationarmy.org; Main: 314-646-3229; Cell: 636-795-9958.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List a specific, named communications director with direct email and phone numbers to facilitate timely responses to media requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish Annual Impact Reports for transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual Impact Reports — FY 2023 (FY23 Annual Report), FY 2022 (FY22 Annual Report), FY 2021 (FY21 Annual Report).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make recent annual impact reports available to media and the public to document organizational impact and provide factual material for stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide headquarters contact information for general inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Get in Touch — The Salvation Army St. Louis Headquarters, 1130 Hampton Avenue, St. Louis, MO 63139, (314) 646-3000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publish the physical address and main phone number of the local headquarters so media and community members can reach the organization for general information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Redirect non-local or international inquiries to appropriate websites
rubrics_metrics.description: For information on The Salvation Army’s work in other parts of the United States, visit our National website or visit our International website for information on The Salvation Army’s work around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear signposting directing media and the public to national or international offices/websites when inquiries fall outside the local/divisional scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publicize organizational mission to inform messaging
rubrics_metrics.description: The Salvation Army Mission Statement: 'The Salvation Army, an international movement, is an evangelical part of the universal Christian Church. Its message is based on the Bible. Its ministry is motivated by the love of God. Its mission is to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ and to meet human needs in His name without discrimination.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the mission statement readily available so media understand the organization's values and framing when reporting; press materials and spokesperson remarks should be consistent with this mission.
